title: DEGIRO Product
description: Represents a tradable financial instrument discoverable via the DEGIRO product search API, including stocks, ETFs, bonds, options, futures, warrants, leveraged products, and investment funds.

name.description: Full name of the financial instrument

symbol.description: Ticker symbol used on the primary listing exchange

contractSize.description: Number of underlying units per contract (for derivatives)

productType.description: Asset class category (e.g. STOCK, ETF, BOND, OPTION, FUTURE, WARRANT, FUND)

productTypeId.description: Numeric code corresponding to the product type

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the product is denominated

exchangeId.description: DEGIRO exchange identifier for the primary listing venue

tradable.description: Whether this product can be traded in the current DEGIRO account

closePriceDate.description: Date of the closing price in YYYY-MM-DD format
